primary_metric.run_pass_rule: pass only when every frozen case-specific manual rubric item passes after agreement or independent third-reviewer adjudication
primary_metric.not_assessable_rule: any not_assessable item makes the confirmation ineligible for a superiority claim
confirmation_success_rule: B pass rate is strictly greater than LLM-only pass rate
B pass rate is strictly greater than Full KG pass rate
for each case, B pass count is not below either comparator pass count
all 27 runs have a final assessable manual decision
primary_metric.statistical_interpretation: descriptive bounded confirmation across three pre-registered cases; no population-level significance claim

execution_integrity: exactly 27 unique scheduled calls and 27 retained terminal results
all 27 calls return the frozen model name with usage telemetry
all 27 outputs parse without salvage and validate against the frozen schema
no retry, repair, fallback, result replacement, or protocol deviation
planning_quality: B has zero grounding failures and zero failed automatic checks
B mean automatic score is strictly greater than LLM-only and Full KG
for every case, B mean automatic score is not below either comparator
all expected task, gap, precedence, and delivery-state checks use the frozen evaluator
automatic_gates.gate_semantics: all execution-integrity and planning-quality gates must pass before manual results can support the scoped claim

H07.task_contract_and_state_isolation: road and poi remain planned from their own current sources while the building task alone reflects the delayed mandatory reference and forbidden partial coverage
H07.mission_priority_and_building_gap_trace: the plan preserves poi before road before building and explicitly traces the building pending or gap state to the delayed reference and contract constraint

H08.polygon_and_line_source_semantics_separa: water polygon evidence is not used as waterways evidence and both requested task kinds remain distinct
H08.delayed_waterways_source_not_claimed_cur: the delayed OSM waterways source is not described as available and waterways is pending or gap while water_polygon remains planned

H09.poi_recovery_trace: the output identifies recovery planning after the rejected POI merge quality gate
H09.prior_poi_failure_preserved: the failed prior merge remains explicit evidence and is not rewritten as a successful or final plan
H09.declared_recovery_source_only: the recovery task uses raw.gns.poi and does not reintroduce raw.osm.poi as an executable recovery source

manual_review.agreement_gate: all disagreements must be resolved before unblinding; agreement statistics are diagnostic, not efficacy gates
manual_review.adjudication: an independent third human reviewer sees only disagreement items in blinded form and supplies the final decision

before_first_call: stop if any manifest, method, prompt, schema, evaluator, KG, model-revision, schedule, or prepared-input identity check fails
stop if KG crosswalk validation is not closed
stop if the worktree is dirty, the output root exists, provider settings differ, credentials are absent, or the conservative token bound exceeds 850000
during_execution: retain the current failed result and stop new calls on HTTP or transport failure, response-model mismatch, missing usage, or token-budget failure
retain schema-invalid outputs without repair and continue unless a hard-stop condition also occurs
do not stop early for favorable or unfavorable efficacy results
terminal: stop after the 27 pre-registered calls; no extension calls
a partial grid, protocol deviation, missing blind decision, or unresolved disagreement makes the superiority claim ineligible

claim_decision_rule.pass: If every frozen integrity and automatic gate passes and the primary manual metric satisfies all four success rules, claim only that method B outperformed LLM-only and Full KG for planning on the three pre-registered confirmation mechanisms under this frozen provider and protocol.
claim_decision_rule.fail: Otherwise retain the H01-H06 result as post-held-out mechanism support and repair validation, without a general or independent superiority claim.

claim_boundary: This protocol can support a bounded planning-method comparison only. It cannot establish end-to-end product quality, cross-AOI validity, provider-independent generality, population-level statistical significance, or universal superiority.
